claim: Collect paired, terminal-response training labels; the target is the effect of acquiring a tree on the official own-minus-opponent margin. Two maps alone do not support a fitted deployment head.
examiner: Original default full Master3s2 source. Complete games use default temperature 1 and unseeded game sampling. Native hold/buy response arms share a registered continuation RNG and initial warm cost table inside each root; first opponent command remains the actual simultaneously submitted command. All subsequent decisions are live and official terminal scores are independently replayed. Neither examiner commands, weights nor hidden carbon are policy-training inputs.
quota: At most one source root per seat and window; two per game, eight total. Register both held-out maps but never collect their response labels in this batch.
exposure: Predecision exposed_return = sum of enemy collector cargo within toroidal distance 4 of the closest enemy base; high if >=160. productive_area = count of unique orthogonal neighbors of own trees with at least 10 turns nominal life left after excluding known tree and base cells; high if >=12. enemy_planter_threat if nearest opponent planter distance to the current candidate cell <=2. Retain continuous values, counts and complete legal candidate-position observations. These public features are computed identically for pay and defer.
strata: Rank each window by hamming distance to its frozen desired_exposure_bits (rotated within each map), baseline-orientation mismatch, then SHA of tree-pair-v1|seed|seat|step|uid. No terminal or future opponent signals in selection.
action: For a living planter currently on an affordable empty or enemy-tree cell, compare STAY with a legal non-STAY. If v1 moves, preserve that exact MOVE in defer. If v1 stays, select a feasible direction minimizing immediate public hazard and friendly collision, then maximizing the observed topological and local economic value of its destination; deterministically break ties. Force just the selected focal command during true autoregressive decoding, and reject alternatives that alter other submitted commands or create a friendly collision. V1 continues unchanged in both arms after the tested step. Include no-payment/collision as intention-to-treat with realized payment identity flagged; no selective elimination based on returns.
observations: Archive each turn's v1 tape and for all own planter actions the literal geometric commands, candidate cells, public all-joint feasibility masks, occupancy/competing workers, exact acquisition cost, own/opp trees and nearby workers, observable adjacent carbon and known-fraction. Preserve previous 3/5/10 steps per selected worker. Training inputs never use hidden grid or future commands; counterfactual next outcomes remain separate.
labels: Primary target = (own official terminal score - rival score)_pay minus same difference_defer. Store both final scores under each arm, U and WDL, actual debit, first tenure of the acquired tree, whole-fleet economic entries, examiner search dynamics, traces and interventions. Reference v1 and alternative are both replayed with symmetric responder setup. Use the word causal only for these paired simulator interventions with one sample per arm, retaining unidentifiable wall-clock variation.
responder_rng: Use exact per-case training_job_registry.rng_seed from the cross-intake registry.
fit_rule: This intake has only two independent maps. Archive labels and map-stratified coverage and do not fit or promote a generalizing intervention head here. For a later fit, preregister at least 8 distinct source maps, 32 valid paired interventions, both margin-effect signs on at least two maps, and map-level cross-validation before unlocking either reserved development map.
retry: Resume complete hash-bound raw native source games; preserve failed arms and interrupted artifacts. Run at most two full original workers on CPUs 0/1; reserve 2/3 for workforce. Start no formal map or extra game outside the registered blocks.
source_math: A state also carries a map-index-independent risk bit in this intake, so enemy-freight exposure is no longer tied to source-map identity.
resources: Source games use core 0/1; responses may use two balanced pairs in parallel as registered in response_resources.json. Do not open other new source map blocks concurrently.
